eyebrow: DMSCO · OMS Web · New authorization engine
title: Authorization Admin

workspace.rolesPlaceholder: The Roles workspace — role catalog, grants, membership — lands in a later slice.

search.placeholder: Search a person — employee id, mobile, or part of the name…
search.hint: Search-first — the estate (~6,000 people) never loads. Results are a server query, capped at 50 rows.

grid.name: Name
grid.emptyHint: Type an employee id, a mobile number, or part of a name — the person grid stays empty until you search (first 50, refine to narrow).

detail.selectHint: Their roles, effective authorizations, and audit history appear here.

roles.outOfScopeHint: This role is outside your delegated scope — you can see it but not revoke it.
roles.removeBody: Revoke {{role}} from {{name}}? Access is removed immediately and the change is audited.
roles.autoCreate: If this person has no authorization record yet, their first role assignment creates it automatically (UserId = employee id, display name from the identity spine) — unguarded, but audited.

assign.title: Assign a role
assign.body: Pick a role to grant. Only roles you're entitled to assign are shown; the server re-checks on assign.
assign.empty: No assignable roles left — this person already holds every role in your scope.

effective.intro: The union of every grant this person resolves to — composites expanded to members, wildcards and $VAR field values shown. The "why can/can't they do X?" answer for a support call.

audit.none: No authorization changes recorded for this person.
audit.legend: Times shown as stored — audit rows are not converted between time zones.

access.deniedTitle: You don't have access to Authorization Admin
access.deniedHint: This screen needs the Authorization Admin permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.
